Maharashtra Approves Unified Electricity Billing for Government Offices

The Maharashtra Cabinet has approved a unified electricity billing system for all government offices across the state. This new system will consolidate billing for electricity consumption. Additionally, the cabinet approved the implementation of prepaid power connections for government facilities. The decision aims to streamline electricity management and potentially improve efficiency in energy usage for state-run offices.
